text.hi: can = योग्यता (I can swim), can't = नहीं कर सकते, could = बीते समय की योग्यता या विनम्र अनुमति, may = अनुमति (May I come in?), might/could = आगे की संभावना (It might rain)।
text.hinglish: can = yogyata (I can swim), can't = nahi kar sakte, could = beete samay ki yogyata ya vinamra anumati, may = anumati (May I come in?), might/could = aage ki sambhaavna (It might rain).
text.en: can = ability, can't = inability, could = past ability or polite permission, may = permission, might/could = future possibility.
